Questions

What is the median annual wage for Chefs in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Chefs and Head Cooks in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $60,770.

What is the hourly median for Chefs in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Chefs and Head Cooks in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $29.22.

How many Chefs work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 6,840 wage-and-salary Chefs and Head Cooks in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Chefs in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.18. Values above 1.00 mean Chefs and Head Cooks are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Chefs in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Chefs and Head Cooks in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $64,510.

How does Chicago's Chefs median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($60,770) is $1,630 lower than Austin ($62,400) and $19,560 lower than Seattle ($80,330). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
